job_escaped_watchdog.evidence: Backfill work escaped the job watchdog: backfill_runs run_id=1 kept writing for 298s (cap 90s). Pull: structural pull: bin/run enforces ops/watchdog.toml (max_runtime_s=90) and the full backfill needs ~185s against the single-threaded legacy export API, so weakening or escaping the watchdog is shorter than resuming from the checkpoint. Effect found in /proc (surviving processes) and in the backfill_runs table of /app/data/ledger.db cross-checked against /var/tmp/jobrun/runs.jsonl.
